versions.changelog: Verified against LintLang 0.8.3. The pinned fallback runner and install guidance now use 0.8.3, repo discovery includes Cursor project rules, and the seeded detector check reflects the current release.

Initial ClawHub release. Source: github.com/hermes-labs-ai/lintlang@86dbb28 (main), skills/lintlang/SKILL.md. Teaches agents to install and use the lintlang CLI: scan, --discover, --format json, exit-code semantics, verdict interpretation, output-is-data injection guard. All commands verified live against lintlang 0.8.1; passed independent adversarial review 2026-09-29.
